title: Project Planner Google Sheets & Excel, Gantt Chart Template, Project Tracker, Task Tracker Spreadsheet, Project Management Dashboard
desc:
A project planner for Google Sheets and Excel with a Gantt chart that draws itself. List your projects, add one row per task, and the Timeline, Dashboard and Phone view fill themselves in. See every project's progress, what's late and what's due soon at a glance. Made for freelancers, small teams, home projects and side businesses.

You get a PDF with links to your own Google Sheet (a blank copy and a filled-in example), plus the same planner as an Excel file. Use the Dashboard and Timeline on your laptop and the Phone tab in the free Google Sheets app. Not a printable.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: open the PDF, tap the link and press "Make a copy". Or open the Excel file. Nothing is shipped.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Start Here: set up in 3 easy steps
• Setup: your name and up to 8 people (or just you), plus how many days count as "due soon"
• Projects: up to 12 projects with client or area, lead, deadline and status. Tasks, done, progress bar, status (On track, Behind, Late, Done) and the next task fill in
• Tasks: room for 300 tasks. Project, owner, status and priority from dropdowns, start and due dates, notes. Timing fills in: Late, Due in 3 days, Starts 4 Dec. Filter buttons show one owner or status
• Timeline: a Gantt chart that draws itself from your tasks. One project or all, days or weeks, bars coloured by status, today highlighted
• Dashboard: pick one project or all of them and every chart follows. Progress, late tasks, due in 7 days and the next deadline, each with a mini chart. Tasks due each week, where tasks stand, who's on what, 6 key checks with status, every project at a glance and what needs attention. Built for a laptop screen
• Phone: what's late, what's due in the next 7 days and every project's progress, with an "Add a task" link

WHY IT'S EASY
• Pick from lists instead of typing the same names again
• No formulas to write and no chart to build
• Status updates itself when a task is late or done
• See who's on what: open, late and due soon per person

PLANNING YOUR WEEK TOO? Our Weekly Planner has a Monday to Sunday plan and a Today list for your phone, in the same look. Search KovaStudioHQ on Etsy.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The photos show example data. Your blank copy starts empty
• Google Sheets needs a free Google account. The Excel file works in Microsoft Excel
• It does not send reminders or emails. It shows where things stand when you open it
• One Kova look, no colour themes
• The Excel file has a simpler dashboard
• For personal use only. Please don't share or resell the file or link
• Digital file, so no returns, but message us and we'll help with anything

Designed and built by Kova Studio. AI tools helped during the build.
